Quiz Maker

Author multiple-choice quizzes, then take them with instant scoring.

Author questions

Take the quiz

📖 How to use

  1. Stay in Author mode and add questions with 4 options each.
  2. Mark the correct option for each question.
  3. Switch to Take Quiz mode and answer all questions.
  4. Submit to see your score with answer review.

❓ Frequently asked questions

How do I create and take a quiz?

Click Author mode, add questions with 4 options and mark the correct one. Switch to Take mode to answer and get scored.

What does a valid question need?

Each question needs its text, all four options filled, and exactly one correct answer selected.

How is the quiz scored?

The score screen shows your %, and each question marked right or wrong with the correct answer revealed.

Is my quiz saved?

In this browser's localStorage — the quiz you author is saved between visits.
